about: 蓝白 · 星海的朝向与数据（Sky/Source~/make_starsky.py 生成）。Unity 世界坐标，方位 = 从 +Z 顺时针到 +X。

sources.stars: Yale Bright Star Catalogue 5th rev. ed. (Hoffleit & Warren 1991), NASA ADC, public domain; JSON github.com/brettonw/YaleBrightStarCatalog
sources.glow: ESA/Gaia/DPAC, Gaia EDR3 all-sky colour map (CC BY-SA 3.0 IGO), as packaged in the mw_plot Python package (MIT, H. Leung); the derived StarSky_Glow texture is therefore CC BY-SA 3.0 IGO (credit ESA/Gaia/DPAC)
sources.faint_stars: Hipparcos main catalogue (ESA 1997) via d3-celestial stars.14.json (BSD-3-Clause)
sources.milky_way_outline: Milky Way Outline Catalog, Jose R. Vieira (skymap.com), via d3-celestial mw.json (BSD-3-Clause)
